thesis: Mohnish Pabrai visited JNV Bangalore to meet students after COVID disruptions prevented his usual annual campus visits. He explained that while he initially encouraged students to donate 10% of their income once successful, he later stopped promoting this idea because the students are too poor and burdened with family financial problems to consider it at that stage.
